question: Should runtime i18n localize gateway JSON message/reason fields that clients may parse, or should those fields stay stable with localized display text handled elsewhere?
rationale: The PR intentionally localizes gateway-facing text, but the current codebase also uses stable type/code fields; deciding whether message/reason strings are display-only is an API compatibility choice that source inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Keep Protocol-Facing Text Stable
options.body: Keep JSON message/reason strings stable and localize only presentation surfaces unless a client contract says otherwise.

options.title: Accept Localized Display Fields
options.body: Treat gateway message/reason strings as display-only and accept locale-dependent values after documenting that clients must use type/code fields.

options.title: Pause Gateway Scope
options.body: Land narrower runtime/channel localization first and defer gateway JSON localization to a dedicated compatibility discussion.

recommendation.title: Keep Protocol-Facing Text Stable
recommendation.body: Keep JSON message/reason strings stable and localize only presentation surfaces unless a client contract says otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is tied to the overlapping auth-copy contract and recent gateway/runtime ownership signals, making them the best available reviewer for the compatibility choice.
